verses.original: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ lə·haz·kîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî Yah·weh lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of David To bring remembrance Make haste, O God to deliver me Hurry O LORD to help me
verses.literalPt: APRESSA-TE, ó Deus, em me livrar; SENHOR, apressa-te em ajudar-me.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū wə·yaḥ·pə·rū mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šî yis·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·yik·kā·lə·mū ḥă·p̄ê·ṣê rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded may those who wish me harm be repelled . . . and humiliated
verses.literalPt: Fiquem envergonhados e confundidos os que procuram a minha alma; voltem para trás e confundam-se os que me desejam mal.

verses.original: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־ עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀ הֶאָֽח׃
verses.literal: May those who say Aha aha retreat because of . . . their shame
verses.literalPt: Virem as costas como recompensa da sua vergonha os que dizem: Ah! Ah!

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־ מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śî·śū wə·yiś·mə·ḥū bə·ḵā kāl- mə·ḇaq·še·ḵā wə·yō·mə·rū ṯā·mîḏ yiḡ·dal ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·hă·ḇê yə·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You may those who love Your salvation always say Let God be magnified
verses.literalPt: Folguem e alegrem-se em ti todos os que te buscam; e aqueles que amam a tua salvação digam continuamente: Engrandecido seja Deus.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה־ לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־ תְּאַחַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥū·šāh- lî ‘ez·rî ū·mə·p̄al·ṭî ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’al- tə·’a·ḥar
verses.literal: But I am poor and needy hurry to me O God You are my help and my deliverer O LORD do not delay
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, estou aflito e necessitado; apressa-te por mim, ó Deus. Tu és o meu auxílio e o meu libertador; SENHOR, não te detenhas.
